title: Theoretical localisation limit: Cramer-Rao bound for the simulated impact, versus the deterministic baseline of E-001
notes: Finite-difference steps per parameter. Pixels used: target-plane radius <= region_radius_mm (the outer edge of the baseline's annulus), so the card edge - whose position relative to the print is not controlled - carries no information. Roll is treated as known (gravity reference), as in E-001. Motion-blur length and direction are treated as known (optimistic). Quantisation, gamma and compression are not in the bound (they can only lose information). G4 threshold from docs/ml/RECONSTRUCTION_RESEARCH_PLAN.md.
